biggest_catch: The friend must make $500+ in direct deposits within 60 days, and the referral itself expires 90 days after the original referral date.
catches: Friend must open a new checking account with a direct deposit of $500+ within 60 days.
Referral offer expires 90 days after the original referral date.
Both individuals must be 18+; offer subject to CU membership eligibility.
Rewards sent within 15-20 business days after the direct deposit is made.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Smart Financial Credit Union's official page (smartcu.org/referral) runs a Credit Union Referral Program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer receives a $50 e-gift card for each friend who opens a new Smart Financial checking account with direct deposit, up to $500 per year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: enter the email associated with the Smart Financial account and share the personal referral code via social channels or email; the friend must receive the referral link from a member, then open a new Smart Financial checking account with direct deposit using that personal referral link. Direct deposit is defined as an electronic deposit totaling $500+ within a 60-day period.

c4.evidence: Timing: rewards are sent within 15-20 business days after the direct deposit is made; both parties receive a $50 e-gift card.

eligibility: Smart Financial Credit Union members referring friends age 18+; referred friend must meet CU membership eligibility.
notes: If the new member uses a checking account to establish membership, a one-time $5 entrance fee applies.
payout_quote: You'll get a $50 Gift Card when your friend meets all requirements.
payout_value_note: $50 e-gift card emailed to the referrer.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral sharing is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Cap: up to $500 per year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); the offer expires 90 days after the original referral date.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: enter the email associated with the Smart Financial account to get a personal referral code; share via Facebook, Twitter, or email.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: receive the referral link from a member; open a new Smart Financial checking account with direct deposit using the friend's personal referral link; direct deposit totals $500+ within 60 days.

steps: Enter your Smart Financial account email to generate your personal referral code.
Share the code with friends via Facebook, Twitter, or email.
Friend opens a new Smart Financial checking account with direct deposit using your link (within 90 days of the referral).
Friend makes $500+ in direct deposits within 60 days.
You each receive a $50 e-gift card within 15-20 business days.
timing: Rewards sent within 15-20 business days after the direct deposit is made.
